what_it_means: An online conversion: a form or chat sent on the site, with its event ID, saved in the submission store. The qualified conversion (the one the platforms bid on) is the subset whose answers clear the line
applies: Entry stage for web forms, chat and platform lead forms

what_it_means: A record in your systems that isn't a lead yet. Where the systems hold conversions as prospects first, every conversion passes through it. Names that never converted enter here too: a bought list, a trade show's scans, contacts sent in through an API, names the team has cultivated
set_by: The import, the API, the marketing system or the CRM
applies: Only where the systems hold conversions or names as prospects before they're leads. Grey it out where conversions become leads directly. Entry stage for lists, trade shows, data feeds and cultivated names

what_it_means: Someone who has raised a hand, on any track: a web conversion, an inbound call, a referral, a prospect who replied or booked a call. One record and the lead ID. A duplicate or a test is a conversion, never a new lead
set_by: The endpoint for web leads, the CRM for every other track
applies: Entry stage for calls and referrals; every track passes through it

what_it_means: The subset of leads that meet the qualifying criteria, whatever track they came in on. Not the same as the qualified conversion
set_by: The qualifying rules, applied to what the lead told you, on a form or on a call

what_it_means: Sales reached the lead and the conversation confirmed the interest. Sales accepts it as worth working
set_by: The rep, from a logged conversation

what_it_means: The rep has qualified it against what the offer needs: the size, the need and the timing
The opportunity reaches a real commitment, such as a signed application or an accepted proposal
Underwriting or the risk review approved it. Only business models with underwriting have this stage
applies: Only with underwriting or a risk review. Grey it out otherwise

what_it_means: Signed, funded, or the first payment received
The account is live: the first transaction, the first invoice
Each month the account bills, by account ID
